rendered-monitoring.rule:
groups:
  - name: outbox-backlog
    rules:
      - alert: OutboxBacklog
        expr: |
          max by (cluster, namespace, job) (outbox_backlog_depth{state="PENDING"}) > 5000
          or
          max by (cluster, namespace, job) (outbox_oldest_pending_age_seconds) > 300
        labels:
          severity: p2
          owner: platform
        annotations:
          summary: Outbox pending backlog exceeds 5000 rows or five minutes
          runbook: http://127.0.0.1:63435/runbook
